race.comment: Decimated strength wise after several raced in the Palmerston Sprint here Saturday. ZOURATA (3) is a progressive type in good form. Led throughout here last time to score over 1100m and has placed 3/4 this course and distance. Has the speed to lead and should feature again. ARIZONA ACTIVIST (4) was safely held here on Saturday but can do much better this level. Won only try this sharper trip.  SHIRSHOV (9) is fitter for two runs back and looks ready to fire.  REWARDS AND MORE (7) is coming back from weight for age and is worth another try. ZING TO WIN (10) is a former WA sprinter having first run this area and is a huge watch. Rates well so don't underestimate.
